feature: Every line of a title's headline shows
summary: A title headline that wraps onto a second or third line now shows every line, after a theme, font pair or energy change and after you type longer words into it. The lines under it move down to make room, a line never runs off the side of the picture, and a headline too long for the frame is set smaller until it fits.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no switch changed from its default. Checked on the probe with the walk hand-work-survives-new-numbers-and-a-restyle-walk (no flags), plus a core test of all 22 shelf styles with one, five and ten word headlines on 1920x1080 and 1280x800, before and after Sunset, Editorial and Punchy.

try.do: Open a video, open the Library, choose Catalog and add a Main Title.
try.shotNote: Before the fix (2026-11-22): Sunset, Editorial and Punchy left only "The Long Way".

try.do: In the Title section, pick the Sunset theme, set Font Pair to Editorial and Energy to Punchy.
Check that the headline reads The Long Way, then Home on a second line, with A FILM BY JUNE HALE under both.
Double-click the headline and type a ten word line, then click outside the title to finish.
Add a Condensed Poster, type Every window. One glance. into its headline and play its entrance.
Scrub slowly through the entrance and watch each word's letters as it lands.

evaluate: Does every line of the headline show after you change the theme, font pair and energy?
When the headline grows to two or three lines, does the line under it sit where you expect, not on top of it?
When a headline is too long, is shrinking it to fit better than letting it run off the frame?
In the Condensed Poster entrance, do the letters land whole, with nothing sliced off their tops or bottoms once they arrive?
rough: A headline set smaller to fit keeps that smaller size if you later type shorter words; it does not grow back to the style's size. Logged on the task, not filed.
A centred title page grows downwards when its headline wraps, so a three line headline sits lower than the style centres it. Logged on the task.
Gradient Glow's colour band grows with a wrapped headline, but the band slides across a box twice the first line's width, so a long second line can catch less of the colour.

The contact sheet and the Condensed Poster reel are offscreen renders with the app's own type measurement, not captures of the window; the restyled Main Title picture is a real capture from the probe.
